title: Universal Dark Mode Contrast Auditor & Real-DOM WCAG 2.1 AA Anti-Inversion Scanner (Full 68-Route Real-DOM Audit, Automated Color Matrix & Zero-Bleed Token Enforcement)
spec:
# DIR-023: Universal Dark Mode Contrast Auditor & Real-DOM WCAG 2.1 AA Anti-Inversion Scanner

## 1. Executive Context & Objectives (Threat Defense)
As the platform expands to cover Candidate, Recruiter, Enterprise, and Admin dashboards, dark mode support must be mathematically proven rather than assumed. Untokenized legacy utility classes (e.g. hardcoded `text-slate-900`, `bg-white`, or light utility tints like `bg-emerald-50`, `bg-indigo-50`, `border-slate-200`) can inadvertently survive reviews, causing unreadable dark-on-dark text in dark mode, washed-out light-on-light text in light mode, or glaring 'pastel island inversions' where bright white/mint badges and buttons sit on dark backgrounds.

This directive mandates:
1. An automated, full-system **Universal Dark Mode Contrast Auditor** that physically crawls all 74 canonical routes in Playwright, composites multi-layered semi-transparent glassmorphic backgrounds down to opaque canvases, computes exact WCAG 2.1 relative luminance ratios, fixes any contrast breaches with Cuba tokens, and seals the results in `.bridge/evidence/UNIVERSAL_CONTRAST_CENSUS.json`.
2. **MANDATORY ROOT CAUSE ANALYSIS (RCA) ON DARK MODE RESIDUE**:
   - Conduct a systematic audit of all inner dashboard and workspace components (e.g. `/build-resume`, `/dashboard/*`, `/employer/*`, `/admin/*`, `/org/*`) to identify where light-mode utility classes (`bg-emerald-50`, `bg-indigo-50`, `bg-amber-50`, `bg-slate-100`, `border-slate-200`, `bg-white/95`) remain un-themed.
   - Eliminate all 'pastel islands' (such as completed step pills, action buttons, info boxes, and guide cards glowing bright white in dark mode).
   - Ensure all tinted elements in dark mode seamlessly adopt executive Cuba dark tokens (`--cuba-card`, `--cuba-elevated`, `--cuba-line`, `--cuba-dark-success-soft`, etc.) with contrast >= 4.5:1.

## 2. Key Architecture Directives
1. **Real-DOM Ancestor Alpha Compositing Engine**:
   - For every element, traverse parent DOM nodes, parse `getComputedStyle(node).backgroundColor`, and composite alpha channels ($A_{\text{fg}} \times C_{\text{fg}} + (1 - A_{\text{fg}}) \times C_{\text{bg}}$) down to `:root` `--cuba-canvas`.
   - Calculate relative luminance: $L = 0.2126R + 0.7152G + 0.0722B$ (sRGB to linear space).
   - Evaluate contrast ratio: $(L_{\text{bright}} + 0.05) / (L_{\text{dark}} + 0.05)$.

2. **Full-Route Crawler Across 4 Authenticated Portals**:
   - Authenticate with valid Firebase test credentials across all 4 roles:
     - Candidate: `/dashboard`, `/dashboard/cover-letters`, `/dashboard/interview`, `/dashboard/job-tracker`, `/dashboard/settings`, `/build-resume`, `/portfolio/builder`.
     - Recruiter: `/employer`, `/employer/applicants`, `/employer/jobs`, `/employer/company`, `/employer/messages`, `/employer/settings`.
     - Enterprise: 14 `/org/:slug/*` routes.
     - Admin: 22 `/admin/*` routes.
     - Public: 13 canonical routes.

3. **Defect Remediation & Token Harmonization**:
   - For any probe failing $4.5:1$ (normal) or $3.0:1$ (large text), surgically update the component using `--cuba-ink`, `--cuba-ink-muted`, `--cuba-card`, `--cuba-line`, or centralized token layers.
   - Zero raw hex colors introduced.

4. **Continuous Quality Gate Integration**:
   - Provide npm script `npm run audit:contrast`.
   - Enforce zero violations ($0$ errors allowed).
invariants: INV-1: Frozen Baseline Integrity: git diff e314f715 -- src/cv-templates/ backend/services/aiRuntime.js must remain STRICTLY 0 bytes (57 CV templates + AI runtime frozen).
INV-2: Real-DOM Proofs: Contrast must be computed from actual browser getComputedStyle and ancestor alpha compositing, never regex or synthetic heuristics.
INV-3: Zero Untokenized Hex in Core UI: New or modified UI layers must consume semantic --cuba-* tokens rather than hardcoded raw hex colors.
INV-4: Print Media Query Exemption: Physical printer stylesheets (@media print) conserving ink with explicit #ffffff and #000000 are valid and excluded from dark mode rules.
INV-5: Performance Budget: Audit script execution time < 120s across all routes; zero runtime latency added to client bundle.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-1: Comprehensive Real-DOM Contrast Crawler: Author .bridge/evidence/universal-contrast-audit.mjs using Playwright to crawl all 68 canonical routes across both Light and Dark themes, extracting real computed foreground/background colors for every text element (h1-h6, p, span, button, input, label, badge).

AC-2: Mathematical WCAG 2.1 Relative Luminance Validation: Compute exact contrast ratios according to W3C relative luminance formula (L1 + 0.05) / (L2 + 0.05), flagging any element with ratio < 4.5:1 (normal text) or < 3.0:1 (large text >= 24px or bold >= 18.66px).

AC-3: Zero Dark Mode Text Inversions: Eliminate all text inversions where dark text (#0f172a, #1e293b, #334155) is rendered on dark backgrounds (#0f172a, #15181f, #1b1f29) or white text on white backgrounds, fixing any offending components with semantic --cuba-* tokens.
AC-4: Automated Contrast Evidence Ledger: Generate .bridge/evidence/UNIVERSAL_CONTRAST_CENSUS.json documenting every tested route, total probes, measured ratios, and confirming 0 violations.
AC-5: CI/CD Contrast Quality Gate: Add 'npm run audit:contrast' to package.json, which executes the crawler and exits with non-zero status if any WCAG AA violation is detected.
AC-6: Quality Gates Pass: vite build < 4.0s, eslint 0 errors, npm test zero regressions.

plan.summary: DIR-023 CHANGES_REQUESTED remediation: (1) AUDITOR FIX - exclude visually-hidden assistive text (.cuba-sr-only/.sr-only/clip rect(0,0,0,0)/aria-hidden) from visual contrast scoring via isAuditable() in dir023-contrast-engine.mjs, recorded as an auditable exemption counter (not a silent drop). (2) SELF-FOUND AUDITOR DEFECT - fastBackground() resets gradientCandidates when it reaches an opaque ancestor, which also erases the ELEMENT'S OWN gradient, inventing white-on-white 1.0 on .enterprise-matrix-all-grant, .enterprise-button-primary/-danger and .enterprise-chip-count (124 false FAILs). Fix: tag candidates with depth and only discard candidates deeper than the opaque fill. (3) UI FIXES with --cuba-*/--ep-* tokens only, zero raw hex: .enterprise-matrix-deny gets a real danger badge treatment (--cuba-danger-soft fill + --cuba-danger ink, 4.86:1 light / 6.64:1 dark) instead of 1.49:1; .enterprise-button-primary gets an explicit background-color plus 600->700 gradient stops (worst stop 4.47:1 -> 6.29:1); centralized token mapping for bg-slate-400 (2.56:1 -> 7.93:1) and bg-[#4a6cf7] (4.39:1 -> 5.41:1) in cuba-tokens.css. Re-run audit:contrast and report the TRUE residual count, not an asserted 0.
steps: 4. Add bg-slate-400 / bg-[#4a6cf7] fill mapping in cuba-tokens.css
6. Report true residual honestly + submit evidence

evidence.summary: DIR-023 PASS 5 COMPLETE: Full census of 591 opacity-modifier classes in src/ mapped into cuba-tokens.css. Solves RC-6 where Tailwind escaped-slash classes (.bg-emerald-50\/70, .border-emerald-200\/90, .text-emerald-700\/90, .bg-indigo-50\/70, .bg-white\/80) bypassed bare utilities. Live Chromium DOM probe confirms bg-emerald-50/70 paints soft dark tint rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.21) and text-emerald-700/90 paints rgb(110, 231, 183) at 9.8:1 contrast. 15/15 dir023-contrast-tokens tests pass, 67/67 security/static tests pass, npm run build in 5.18s, INV-1 diff = 0 bytes. Updated SWOT with RC-6 in DIR-023-RCA-SWOT.md.

reviews.feedback:
DIR-023 Plan APPROVED.
1. Scope & Strategy: Exceptional architectural recon. The dual-path contrast engine (alpha compositing walk + canvas getImageData sampling for gradients/blend-modes/backdrop-filter) successfully neutralizes the known false-positive/negative artifacts documented in dir018 and dir012.
2. Authoritative Manifest: Approved to dynamically derive all ~100+ canonical routes from main.jsx, DashboardMain.jsx, EmployerPortal.jsx, Admin.jsx, and ENTERPRISE_TABS, superseding the 68 estimate.
3. Universal Authentication: Approved to use ADMIN_EMAIL via mintFirebaseSession() for authentic cross-portal access across Candidate, Recruiter, Enterprise, and Admin surfaces.
4. Concurrency & Performance Budget: 4-worker Playwright concurrency approved; INV-5 budget ceiling adjusted to < 180s for the full 100+ route dual-theme crawl.
5. Invariants: Enforce strictly 0-byte diff against e314f715 on src/cv-templates/ and backend/services/aiRuntime.js (INV-1), zero raw hex (INV-3), and crawler-side @media print exemption (INV-4).

You are authorized to proceed in ACT mode.

DIR-023 Evidence Review: Outstanding architectural foundation and dual-path relative luminance engine. 74 canonical routes successfully discovered and audited x light+dark (28,120 probes in 101.9s). Tokenization of brand blue to --cuba-ink-accent (6.73:1) and dark-mode card background mapping are verified effective. Invariant INV-1 is strictly 0 lines diff (INV1_DIFF_EMPTY=True), and Vite build is clean in 3.14s.

REASON FOR CHANGES_REQUESTED:
Per AC-4 and AC-5, the universal contrast census must confirm 0 violations and 'npm run audit:contrast' must exit with code 0 before release certification. The current census records 2,072 residual violations.

ACTIONABLE CORRECTIONS TO ACHIEVE 0 VIOLATIONS:
1. Filter Assistive Offscreen Text: As outlined in Step 6 of your plan, exclude elements with .cuba-sr-only, .sr-only, or clip: rect(0,0,0,0) from visual contrast scoring. They are visually hidden screen-reader tags (e.g. 141+ occurrences) and not painted text.
2. Enterprise Matrix Deny Badges: In /org/:slug/access, 236 spans with 'enterprise-matrix-deny' render gray on white. Ensure they have appropriate background contrast or are classified as disabled decorative indicators.
3. White-on-White Buttons: Ensure .btn-primary and button classes have an explicit background-color fill in light mode so white button text passes effortlessly.

Apply these targeted exclusions and fixes, re-run 'npm run audit:contrast' to confirm 0 violations, and re-submit for immediate APPROVED_FROZEN certification.

Remediation plan APPROVED.
1. Excellent identification and fix for fastBackground() gradientCandidates depth tag.
2. Filtering .cuba-sr-only/.sr-only/clip rect(0,0,0,0)/aria-hidden as auditable exemptions aligns with W3C WCAG guidelines.
3. Tokenized treatment for .enterprise-matrix-deny and button fills is authorized.
Proceed in ACT mode to re-run audit:contrast.

[LEAD SUPERVISOR GATEKEEPER AUDIT: CHANGES REQUESTED - RESIDUAL PASTEL OPACITY MODIFIERS FOUND]

1. RESIDUAL ROOT CAUSE CONFIRMED:
While your mapping of bare pastel classes (.bg-emerald-50, .border-emerald-200, etc.) was architecturally sound, your static census and live DOM test ONLY tested the bare class names.
In real components (e.g. StepGuide.jsx line 92, BuildResume.jsx lines 1914, FavoritesModal, MainJobListings, PortfolioComponents, etc.), components use Tailwind Opacity-Modifier syntax:
- StepGuide.jsx: `bg-emerald-50/70`, `border-emerald-200/90`, `text-emerald-700/90`
- BuildResume.jsx: `border-emerald-200/80`
- Recruiter Tip: `bg-indigo-50/70`, `border-indigo-100/70`
- Portfolios & Modals: `bg-white/80`, `bg-white/70`, `bg-white/60`, `bg-white/50`, `bg-white/40`, `bg-white/30`, `bg-white/20`
Tailwind compiles these with escaped slashes (e.g. `.bg-emerald-50\/70`), which bypass the bare `.bg-emerald-50.bg-emerald-50` selector completely. As a result, the user STILL sees bright pastel plates and pale borders on the live screen!

2. MANDATORY REMEDIATION IN src/styles/cuba-tokens.css:
Add doubled-class selectors with escaped slashes for all opacity-modified variants present in src/:
- Emerald: .bg-emerald-50\/40, .bg-emerald-50\/50, .bg-emerald-50\/60, .bg-emerald-50\/70, .bg-emerald-50\/80, .bg-emerald-50\/90
- Emerald borders: .border-emerald-200\/50, .border-emerald-200\/60, .border-emerald-200\/80, .border-emerald-200\/90, .border-emerald-300\/80
- Emerald text: .text-emerald-700\/90
- Indigo: .bg-indigo-50\/20, .bg-indigo-50\/30, .bg-indigo-50\/40, .bg-indigo-50\/50, .bg-indigo-50\/55, .bg-indigo-50\/60, .bg-indigo-50\/70, .bg-indigo-50\/80, .bg-indigo-50\/90
- Indigo borders: .border-indigo-100\/30, .border-indigo-100\/60, .border-indigo-100\/70, .border-indigo-100\/80, .border-indigo-100\/90, .border-indigo-200\/60, .border-indigo-200\/70, .border-indigo-200\/80, .border-indigo-200\/90
- Indigo text: .text-indigo-600\/80, .text-indigo-700\/80, .text-indigo-900\/80
- Amber: .bg-amber-50\/50, .bg-amber-50\/60, .bg-amber-50\/70, .bg-amber-50\/80, .bg-amber-50\/90, .border-amber-200\/60, .border-amber-200\/80, .border-amber-200\/90
- Blue: .bg-blue-50\/15, .bg-blue-50\/20, .bg-blue-50\/50, .bg-blue-50\/60, .bg-blue-50\/80, .border-blue-100\/30, .border-blue-100\/50, .border-blue-200\/50, .border-blue-200\/60, .border-blue-200\/80
- Purple: .bg-purple-50\/50, .bg-purple-50\/60, .bg-purple-50\/70, .bg-purple-50\/80, .border-purple-200\/30, .border-purple-200\/50, .border-purple-200\/60, .border-purple-200\/80, .border-purple-200\/90
- Rose: .bg-rose-50\/40, .bg-rose-50\/60, .bg-rose-50\/70, .border-rose-200\/90
- Sky: .bg-sky-50\/50, .bg-sky-50\/60
- White opacity fills (.bg-white\/80, .bg-white\/70, .bg-white\/60, .bg-white\/50, .bg-white\/40, .bg-white\/30, .bg-white\/20, .bg-white\/10) mapped to color-mix(in srgb, var(--cuba-card) <pct>%, transparent) !important;
- White opacity borders (.border-white\/40, .border-white\/30, .border-white\/20, .border-white\/10) mapped to color-mix(in srgb, var(--cuba-line) <pct>%, transparent) !important;

- Re-run build and verify dist/ contains all escaped selectors.
- Update your SWOT with this exact Root Cause & Resolution.
